notes: TypeSafe official price for Jev, from docs.typesafe.ai/models (as of 2026-11-26 typesafe.ai/pricing redirects to that models page; it returned 404 on 2026-10-07; there is still no separate marketing price page). Raw unit as published: $42 per Btok, i.e. $0.042 per Mtok ("Price (per Btok / per Mtok) | $42 / $0.042"), charged per input token; output tokens are free; no per-request fee or free tier is listed. Rate limits: the models page no longer states fixed token or request caps; limits are set per organization and shown in the developer console, with higher limits available on custom/enterprise plans. THIRD-PARTY RESELLER/AGGREGATOR NOT USED AS A PRICE SOURCE: jevaihub.com/pricing is an independent site ("not affiliated with or endorsed by TypeSafe"); its price still matches ($0.042) and it no longer carries a requests-per-second snapshot. A Vercel AI Gateway price for Jev is reported only by that third-party site: $0.04 per million input tokens as of its 2026-11-12 page update (it previously reported $0.042 under typesafe-ai/jev); still not verified directly (Vercel page 404 on 2026-10-07). Context: docs say 64k tokens per request and 32k per question (the state plus any one question); OpenRouter now lists 262,144 tokens, its long-context mode, and says requests with more than about 32,000 bytes of text, or any request with an image, run in that mode. Jev price per decision depends on state size, questions and fan-out; this table is the raw rate only. Changed figures: OpenRouter-listed context 32,000 -> 262,144 tokens; Vercel AI Gateway price as reported by the third-party site $0.042 -> $0.04.
